sourceFile: 7. MSU-L20S15-07 DT Report test Check iussue Decap bond MG+PT not dry  date 2025.03.18_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but misidentifies the primary change as dates/lines instead of dry temperature increase.
issues: Primary changed factor is wrong; source states dry temperature 80/85°C to 120°C.
Supplier and lot are subgroup context, not proven primary factors.
Baseline and changed conditions are incorrectly built from dates and lines.
Invalid measurement outcomes are parser artifacts and should be removed.
Troubleshooting rows need separation from final 6-day follow-up result.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to dry oven MG/PT temperature increase from 80/85±5°C to 120±5°C.
Use baseline before-change results and after-change total/follow-up rows as main comparison.
Keep date, line, temperature, dry time, supplier, lot, and shift as subgroup context.
Retain process defect outcomes: decap NG and MG/PT separate NG rates.
Remove parser-generated measurement/spec artifacts and irrelevant condition groupings.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but evidence grouping is not sufficient until corrected.
